title: Decoder Table for [[66,13,3]]_3
code: BT1872 [[66,13,3]]_3 finite GF3 CSS matrix code
decoder_rule: For a syndrome pair (sX,sZ), decode Z-type support from the X-face syndrome and X-type support from the Z-vertex-star syndrome. The signed vertex-star columns identify ordered edge endpoints for X errors; the face-boundary columns identify the two incident faces for Z errors.

first_dangerous_collision.relation: edge(0,1) + 2*edge(0,3) + edge(1,3) is a weight-3 dressed logical
first_dangerous_collision.consequence: the weight-2 partial error edge(0,1)+2*edge(0,3) has the same syndrome as the opposite single-edge completion on edge(1,3), so a nearest-single decoder can logical-fail on this class

correction_policy: Correct all weight-1 syndromes. Flag repeated inconsistent syndromes or any syndrome-history pattern compatible with a known weight-3 relation as untrusted rather than claiming weight-2 correction.
boundary: Exact single-error decoder and weight-2 screen for the finite matrix code. It is not a maximum-likelihood decoder, repeated-syndrome decoder, or hardware decoder.
